name: app/toolbar-menu
title: ToolbarMenu
summary: A Toolbar button that opens a short list of choices, each a link (a date range: "Last 24 hours", "Last 7 days"). The current choice is the button's text.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being chosen ("Date range"); the list's name and a visually hidden prefix on the button.

props.name: choices
props.type: { label: string; href: string; current?: boolean }[]
props.description: The choices; each is a URL.

behaviour: The button shows the current choice (the first when none is marked).
The current choice is aria-current="true" with a check.

keyboard: Enter or Space opens and closes.
focus: `--ring` focus ring on the summary and every choice.

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The list opens right-aligned under the button, at least 11rem wide.
contract:
contract
  slot is "toolbar-menu"
  summary "Last 7 days" min_height 32
  when default shows a "Last 24 hours"
end

checks.say: The summary says what is chosen.
